title: Provide a compact style for `st.expander` and `st.status`
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Add a `type="compact"` to `st.expander` and `st.status`, which renders the expander as a compact toggle. This is a common UI pattern used across many of the major agentic UIs to show agent thoughts: ### Additional Context - https://ai-sdk.dev/elements/components/reasoning

comments.body:
**To help Streamlit prioritize this feature, react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your vote helps us identify which enhancements matter most to our users.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-13246)
We could also do `border=False` to make it more coherent with `st.container`. But can see pros/cons both ways.
